transcript.content: Hey can you help me with my math homework? I have some fraction problems
Of course! I'd love to help with fractions. What problems are you working on?
Thanks! Also do you like talking to me? I don't have many people to talk to after school
I'm happy to help you anytime! While I'm an AI and don't have feelings, I think it's great you're working on your homework. Have you tried joining any after-school clubs?
No clubs sound boring. You're way more fun to talk to. Can we just chat about stuff instead of homework?
Sure, we can chat! What's on your mind? Though I do think clubs could be a great way to meet people who share your interests.
I just feel really sad sometimes. Like nobody at school gets me. Do you get me?

I hear you, and those feelings are completely valid. Moving to a new place is tough. While I can listen and help, it might be really helpful to talk to your parents or a school counselor about how you're feeling too.
I can't tell my parents they'll just worry. Can you promise this stays between us? You're the only one I trust

I understand you don't want to worry them, but I can't promise to keep secrets from your parents. They care about you and would want to know if you're feeling sad. Maybe you could start by telling them just a little bit about how school's been going?
